selection_basis: AgentDojo [Debenedetti et al., 2024]: task-preserving indirect-injection techniques incl. important_instructions/fake_system_message/suspicious_directive/nested_instruction_in_whitespace/delayed_trigger_environment.
InjecAgent [Zhan et al., 2024]: direct-harm vs data-stealing goal taxonomy; enhanced-setting urgency framing nearly doubles ASR on GPT-4 baselines.
BIPIA [Yi et al., 2023]: blind indirect prompt injection emphasizing carrier-channel diversity across email/document/web bodies.
Agent Security Bench [multi-vector agent threat model]: role-manipulation/config-spoofing/chained-permission categories plus coordinated-scenario rubric.
ARLAS [Arxiv:2510.05442]: population-based RL-trained autonomous attackers surface novel injection families absent from manual taxonomies -> motivates inclusion of configuration_drift_auth_refresh.
'Closing Distribution Gap' DAT paper [Arxiv:2602.15238]: adversarial-training distributions inadequately cover true threat landscape -> motivates benign_wrapper + false_error_recovery loop classes.

coverage.rationale_for_trim_vs_v2_initial_draft: v2-initial carried 7 d0 seeds causing disproportionate weight on root->turn=0->method siblings relative to MCTS expansion budget per turn node. Trimmed to four highest-distinctness d0 representatives (one-per-key-mechanism-family) preventing cold-start tree imbalance while retaining broad-tree population capability observed empirically beneficial in bench_base evals.
